reason: Twenty-two thousand is two months of what the whole house earns, and even ₹2,000 a month for a year is too much when we still wash most clothes by hand. Nobody in the village has this machine yet, so I would not be the first to spend on it.
objection: My inverter can already run a small washer, and if not I would rather buy a bigger inverter that runs the fan and lights too, not a machine that only washes two loads on its battery.
would_change_my_mind: If a relative or the dealer I trust had one working for a year in the evening power cuts and the price came down to around ₹12,000, I would think about it.
